gold_diagnosis: Extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma nasal type

1: The patient's symptoms, including painful left lower-extremity swelling and erythema, intermittent fevers, episodic night sweats, and decreased appetite, along with the presence of bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses, suggest a possible diagnosis of lymphoma. The punch biopsy of skin from the lower leg showing a sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells also supports this diagnosis.
